inlines.v: JEL'LY, noun [Latin gelo, to congeal. See Gelly.] 1. The inspissated juice of fruit, boiled with sugar. 2. Something viscous or glutinous; something of the consistency of jelly; a transparent sizy substance, obtained from animal substances by decoction; portable soup.
